provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: A Feast for Odin rules summary (Feuerland / Z-Man, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Large action board in the middle
4 players: add the two extension tiles, random side up
Goods boxes, the oval supply board for special tiles and the supply board for ships
Shuffle the 8 mountain strips; {n} faceup with their goods on them
The 4 exploration boards: Shetland, Faroe Islands, Iceland, Greenland side up
Stack the building tiles: sheds, stone houses, long houses
Occupations sorted by back (decks A/B/C; beginners use A): each player draws 1 light brown starting card, the other light brown ones leave the game
Shuffle the dark brown occupations and the weapon cards into facedown piles
Each player: 1 bow and arrow, 1 snare, 1 spear weapon card and 1 mead tile
Each player takes a home board on the long- or short-game side
A Viking on each numbered Banquet Table space (7 long game, 6 short); the rest on your Thing Square
Random start player (the grey moose); in turn, place Vikings on one free action space
